payloads.RING_KEY_UPLOAD: 20 float32 values; dimensions fixed by schema
payloads.FULL_SC_DESCRIPTOR_REQUEST: empty body; target robot/KF in header
payloads.POINT_CLOUD_REQUEST: u8 requested field count=3 (XYZ); target in header
payloads.POINT_CLOUD_RESPONSE: <IB3x count/fields/pad + original float32 XYZ; XYZI alternative benchmarked, intensity not consumed by frozen GICP
payloads.LOOP_CONSTRAINT: <Bqq candidate robot/query KF/candidate KF + 16 float64 SE3 + 6 float64 tangent sigmas [rx,ry,rz,tx,ty,tz] + float64 Huber delta
payloads.ODOMETRY_UPDATE: <Bq kind/previousKF + 16 float64 SE3 + 6 float64 tangent sigmas; kind0 relative odom,1 global prior/initial R1,2 initial R3 local pose (not central prior)
payloads.GLOBAL_POSE_CORRECTION: 7 float64 XYZ+xyzw; header identifies robot/KF; schema/microtest only, not simulated send
payloads.MAP_CHUNK: same point encoding as cloud, from actual Stage20 map; microbenchmark only, no assumed distribution schedule
payloads.ACK_OR_CONTROL: u8 status; synthetic schema test only; no unnecessary ACK invented

transport_packet_headers: NOT_MEASURED; header is application framing only
compression: independent zlib level1 entire message; uncompressed is primary
source_hash: offline trace provenance only; not an uncounted transmitted field
